verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ إِلَيَّ كَلِمَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ قَائِلَةً:
verses.kjv: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.web: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.he: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «يَا ٱبْنَ آدَمَ، عَرِّفْ أُورُشَلِيمَ بِرَجَاسَاتِهَا،
verses.kjv: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.web: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
verses.he: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֹודַ֥ע אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֶת־תֹּועֲבֹתֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: وَقُلْ: هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ لِأُورُشَلِيمَ: مَخْرَجُكِ وَمَوْلِدُكِ مِنْ أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ. أَبُوكِ أَمُورِيٌّ وَأُمُّكِ حِثِّيَّةٌ.
verses.kjv: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity [is] of the land of Canaan; thy father [was] an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
verses.web: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.
verses.he: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מְכֹרֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וּמֹ֣לְדֹתַ֔יִךְ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י אָבִ֥יךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְאִמֵּ֥ךְ חִתִּֽית׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا مِيلَادُكِ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتِ فَلَمْ تُقْطَعْ سُرَّتُكِ، وَلَمْ تُغْسَلِي بِٱلْمَاءِ لِلتَّنَظُّفِ، وَلَمْ تُمَلَّحِي تَمْلِيحًا، وَلَمْ تُقَمَّطِي تَقْمِيطًا.
verses.kjv: And [as for] thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple [thee;] thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.web: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.
verses.he: וּמֹולְדֹותַ֗יִךְ בְּיֹ֨ום הוּלֶּ֤דֶת אֹתָךְ֙ לֹֽא־כָרַּ֣ת שָׁרֵּ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם לֹֽא־רֻחַ֖צְתְּ לְמִשְׁעִ֑י וְהָמְלֵ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א הֻמְלַ֔חַתְּ וְהָחְתֵּ֖ל לֹ֥א חֻתָּֽלְתְּ׃

verses.ar: لَمْ تَشْفُقْ عَلَيْكِ عَيْنٌ لِتَصْنَعَ لَكِ وَاحِدَةً مِنْ هَذِهِ لِتَرِقَّ لَكِ، بَلْ طُرِحْتِ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْحَقْلِ بِكَرَاهَةِ نَفْسِكِ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتِ.
verses.kjv: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.web: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.
verses.he: לֹא־חָ֨סָה עָלַ֜יִךְ עַ֗יִן לַעֲשֹׂ֥ות לָ֛ךְ אַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לְחֻמְלָ֣ה עָלָ֑יִךְ וַֽתֻּשְׁלְכִ֞י אֶל־פְּנֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ בְּגֹ֣עַל נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ בְּיֹ֖ום הֻלֶּ֥דֶת אֹתָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: فَمَرَرْتُ بِكِ وَرَأَيْتُكِ مَدُوسَةً بِدَمِكِ، فَقُلْتُ لَكِ: بِدَمِكِ عِيشِي، قُلْتُ لَكِ: بِدَمِكِ عِيشِي.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee [when thou wast] in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee [when thou wast] in thy blood, Live.
verses.web: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’
verses.he: וָאֶעֱבֹ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וָֽאֶרְאֵ֔ךְ מִתְבֹּוסֶ֖סֶת בְּדָמָ֑יִךְ וָאֹ֤מַר לָךְ֙ בְּדָמַ֣יִךְ חֲיִ֔י וָאֹ֥מַר לָ֖ךְ בְּדָמַ֥יִךְ חֲיִֽי׃

verses.ar: جَعَلْتُكِ رَبْوَةً كَنَبَاتِ ٱلْحَقْلِ، فَرَبَوْتِ وَكَبُرْتِ، وَبَلَغْتِ زِينَةَ ٱلْأَزْيَانِ. نَهَدَ ثَدْيَاكِ، وَنَبَتَ شَعْرُكِ وَقَدْ كُنْتِ عُرْيَانَةً وَعَارِيَةً.
verses.kjv: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: [thy] breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou [wast] naked and bare.
verses.web: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.
verses.he: רְבָבָ֗ה כְּצֶ֤מַח הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נְתַתִּ֔יךְ וַתִּרְבִּי֙ וַֽתִּגְדְּלִ֔י וַתָּבֹ֖אִי בַּעֲדִ֣י עֲדָיִ֑ים שָׁדַ֤יִם נָכֹ֙נוּ֙ וּשְׂעָרֵ֣ךְ צִמֵּ֔חַ וְאַ֖תְּ עֵרֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَمَرَرْتُ بِكِ وَرَأَيْتُكِ، وَإِذَا زَمَنُكِ زَمَنُ ٱلْحُبِّ. فَبَسَطْتُ ذَيْلِي عَلَيْكِ وَسَتَرْتُ عَوْرَتَكِ، وَحَلَفْتُ لَكِ، وَدَخَلْتُ مَعَكِ فِي عَهْدٍ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، فَصِرْتِ لِي.
verses.kjv: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time [was] the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
verses.web: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.
verses.he: וָאֶעֱבֹ֨ר עָלַ֜יִךְ וָאֶרְאֵ֗ךְ וְהִנֵּ֤ה עִתֵּךְ֙ עֵ֣ת דֹּדִ֔ים וָאֶפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֲכַסֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתֵ֑ךְ וָאֶשָּׁ֣בַֽע לָ֠ךְ וָאָבֹ֨וא בִבְרִ֜ית אֹתָ֗ךְ נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה וַתִּ֥הְיִי לִֽי׃

verses.ar: فَحَمَّمْتُكِ بِٱلْمَاءِ، وَغَسَلْتُ عَنْكِ دِمَاءَكِ، وَمَسَحْتُكِ بِٱلزَّيْتِ،
verses.kjv: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.web: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.he: וָאֶרְחָצֵ֣ךְ בַּמַּ֔יִם וָאֶשְׁטֹ֥ף דָּמַ֖יִךְ מֵֽעָלָ֑יִךְ וָאֲסֻכֵ֖ךְ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃

verses.ar: وَأَلْبَسْتُكِ مُطَرَّزَةً، وَنَعَلْتُكِ بِٱلتُّخَسِ، وَأَزَّرْتُكِ بِٱلْكَتَّانِ، وَكَسَوْتُكِ بَزًّا،
verses.kjv: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers’ skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
verses.web: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.he: וָאַלְבִּישֵׁ֣ךְ רִקְמָ֔ה וָאֶנְעֲלֵ֖ךְ תָּ֑חַשׁ וָאֶחְבְּשֵׁ֣ךְ בַּשֵּׁ֔שׁ וַאֲכַסֵּ֖ךְ מֶֽשִׁי׃

verses.ar: وَحَلَّيْتُكِ بِٱلْحُلِيِّ، فَوَضَعْتُ أَسْوِرَةً فِي يَدَيْكِ وَطَوْقًا فِي عُنُقِكِ.
verses.kjv: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.web: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.
verses.he: וָאֶעְדֵּ֖ךְ עֶ֑דִי וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה צְמִידִים֙ עַל־יָדַ֔יִךְ וְרָבִ֖יד עַל־גְּרֹונֵֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَوَضَعْتُ خِزَامَةً فِي أَنْفِكِ وَأَقْرَاطًا فِي أُذُنَيْكِ وَتَاجَ جَمَالٍ عَلَى رَأْسِكِ.
verses.kjv: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
verses.web: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.he: וָאֶתֵּ֥ן נֶ֙זֶם֙ עַל־אַפֵּ֔ךְ וַעֲגִילִ֖ים עַל־אָזְנָ֑יִךְ וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּרֹאשֵֽׁךְ׃

verses.ar: فَتَحَلَّيْتِ بِٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ، وَلِبَاسُكِ ٱلْكَتَّانُ وَٱلْبَزُّ وَٱلْمُطَرَّزُ. وَأَكَلْتِ ٱلسَّمِيذَ وَٱلْعَسَلَ وَٱلزَّيْتَ، وَجَمُلْتِ جِدًّا جِدًّا، فَصَلُحْتِ لِمَمْلَكَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment [was of] fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
verses.web: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
verses.he: וַתַּעְדִּ֞י זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף וּמַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ֙ *שֵׁשִׁי (שֵׁ֤שׁ) וָמֶ֙שִׁי֙ וְרִקְמָ֔ה סֹ֧לֶת וּדְבַ֛שׁ וָשֶׁ֖מֶן *אָכָלְתִּי (אָכָ֑לְתְּ) וַתִּ֙יפִי֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַֽתִּצְלְחִ֖י לִמְלוּכָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَخَرَجَ لَكِ ٱسْمٌ فِي ٱلْأُمَمِ لِجَمَالِكِ، لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ كَامِلًا بِبَهَائِي ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتُهُ عَلَيْكِ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it [was] perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.web: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.he: וַיֵּ֨צֵא לָ֥ךְ שֵׁ֛ם בַּגֹּויִ֖ם בְּיָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י ׀ כָּלִ֣יל ה֗וּא בַּֽהֲדָרִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֣מְתִּי עָלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

verses.ar: «فَٱتَّكَلْتِ عَلَى جَمَالِكِ، وَزَنَيْتِ عَلَى ٱسْمِكِ، وَسَكَبْتِ زِنَاكِ عَلَى كُلِّ عَابِرٍ فَكَانَ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.web: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
verses.he: וַתִּבְטְחִ֣י בְיָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֖י עַל־שְׁמֵ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת־תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִךְ עַל־כָּל־עֹובֵ֖ר לֹו־יֶֽהִי׃

verses.ar: وَأَخَذْتِ مِنْ ثِيَابِكِ وَصَنَعْتِ لِنَفْسِكِ مُرْتَفَعَاتٍ مُوَشَّاةٍ، وَزَنَيْتِ عَلَيْهَا. أَمْرٌ لَمْ يَأْتِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ.
verses.kjv: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: [the like things] shall not come, neither shall it be [so].
verses.web: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.
verses.he: וַתִּקְחִ֣י מִבְּגָדַ֗יִךְ וַתַּֽעֲשִׂי־לָךְ֙ בָּמֹ֣ות טְלֻאֹ֔ות וַתִּזְנִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א בָאֹ֖ות וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃

verses.ar: وَأَخَذْتِ أَمْتِعَةَ زِينَتِكِ مِنْ ذَهَبِي وَمِنْ فِضَّتِي ٱلَّتِي أَعْطَيْتُكِ، وَصَنَعْتِ لِنَفْسِكِ صُوَرَ ذُكُورٍ وَزَنَيْتِ بِهَا.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
verses.web: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.
verses.he: וַתִּקְחִ֞י כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ מִזְּהָבִ֤י וּמִכַּסְפִּי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וַתַּעֲשִׂי־לָ֖ךְ צַלְמֵ֣י זָכָ֑ר וַתִּזְנִי־בָֽם׃

verses.ar: وَأَخَذْتِ ثِيَابَكِ ٱلْمُطَرَّزَةَ وَغَطَّيْتِهَا بِهَا، وَوَضَعْتِ أَمَامَهَا زَيْتِي وَبَخُورِي.
verses.kjv: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
verses.web: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
verses.he: וַתִּקְחִ֛י אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתֵ֖ךְ וַתְּכַסִּ֑ים וְשַׁמְנִי֙ וּקְטָרְתִּ֔י *נָתַתִּי (נָתַ֖תְּ) לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَخُبْزِي ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَيْتُكِ، ٱلسَّمِيذَ وَٱلزَّيْتَ وَٱلْعَسَلَ ٱلَّذِي أَطْعَمْتُكِ، وَضَعْتِهَا أَمَامَهَا رَائِحَةَ سُرُورٍ. وَهَكَذَا كَانَ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, [wherewith] I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and [thus] it was, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.web: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.he: וְלַחְמִי֩ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֜ךְ סֹ֣לֶת וָשֶׁ֤מֶן וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֶֽאֱכַלְתִּ֔יךְ וּנְתַתִּ֧יהוּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ וַיֶּ֑הִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

verses.ar: «أَخَذْتِ بَنِيكِ وَبَنَاتِكِ ٱلَّذِينَ وَلَدْتِهِمْ لِي، وَذَبَحْتِهِمْ لَهَا طَعَامًا. أَهُوَ قَلِيلٌ مِنْ زِنَاكِ
verses.kjv: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. [Is this] of thy whoredoms a small matter,
verses.web: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,
verses.he: וַתִּקְחִ֞י אֶת־בָּנַ֤יִךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלַ֣דְתְּ לִ֔י וַתִּזְבָּחִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם לֶאֱכֹ֑ול הַמְעַ֖ט *מִתַּזְנֻתֵךְ (מִתַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ)׃

verses.ar: أَنَّكِ ذَبَحْتِ بَنِيَّ وَجَعَلْتِهِمْ يَجُوزُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ لَهَا؟
verses.kjv: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through [the fire] for them?
verses.web: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?
verses.he: וַֽתִּשְׁחֲטִ֖י אֶת־בָּנָ֑י וַֽתִּתְּנִ֔ים בְּהַעֲבִ֥יר אֹותָ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: وَفِي كُلِّ رَجَاسَاتِكِ وَزِنَاكِ لَمْ تَذْكُرِي أَيَّامَ صِبَاكِ، إِذْ كُنْتِ عُرْيَانَةً وَعَارِيَةً وَكُنْتِ مَدُوسَةً بِدَمِكِ.
verses.kjv: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, [and] wast polluted in thy blood.
verses.web: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.
verses.he: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־תֹּועֲבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְתַזְנֻתַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א *זָכַרְתִּי (זָכַ֖רְתְּ) אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בִּֽהְיֹותֵךְ֙ עֵרֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֔ה מִתְבֹּוסֶ֥סֶת בְּדָמֵ֖ךְ הָיִֽית׃

verses.ar: وَكَانَ بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَرِّكِ. وَيْلٌ، وَيْلٌ لَكِ! يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ،
verses.kjv: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
verses.web: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—
verses.he: וַיְהִ֕י אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל־רָעָתֵ֑ךְ אֹ֣וי אֹ֣וי לָ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

verses.ar: أَنَّكِ بَنَيْتِ لِنَفْسِكِ قُبَّةً وَصَنَعْتِ لِنَفْسِكِ مُرْتَفَعَةً فِي كُلِّ شَارِعٍ.
verses.kjv: [That] thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
verses.web: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.
verses.he: וַתִּבְנִי־לָ֖ךְ גֶּ֑ב וַתַּעֲשִׂי־לָ֥ךְ רָמָ֖ה בְּכָל־רְחֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: فِي رَأْسِ كُلِّ طَرِيقٍ بَنَيْتِ مُرْتَفَعَتَكِ وَرَجَّسْتِ جَمَالَكِ، وَفَرَّجْتِ رِجْلَيْكِ لِكُلِّ عَابِرٍ وَأَكْثَرْتِ زِنَاكِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
verses.web: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
verses.he: אֶל־כָּל־רֹ֣אשׁ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בָּנִית֙ רָֽמָתֵ֔ךְ וַתְּתַֽעֲבִי֙ אֶת־יָפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִ֥י אֶת־רַגְלַ֖יִךְ לְכָל־עֹובֵ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֖י אֶת־*תַּזְנֻתֵךְ (תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ)׃

verses.ar: وَزَنَيْتِ مَعَ جِيرَانِكِ بَنِي مِصْرَ ٱلْغِلَاظِ ٱللَّحْمِ، وَزِدْتِ فِي زِنَاكِ لِإِغَاظَتِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.web: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.
verses.he: וַתִּזְנִ֧י אֶל־בְּנֵֽי־מִצְרַ֛יִם שְׁכֵנַ֖יִךְ גִּדְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֥י אֶת־תַּזְנֻתֵ֖ךְ לְהַכְעִיסֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: «فَهَأَنَذَا قَدْ مَدَدْتُ يَدِي عَلَيْكِ، وَمَنَعْتُ عَنْكِ فَرِيضَتَكِ، وَأَسْلَمْتُكِ لِمَرَامِ مُبْغِضَاتِكِ، بَنَاتِ ٱلْفِلِسْطِينِيِّينَ، ٱللَّوَاتِي يَخْجَلْنَ مِنْ طَرِيقِكِ ٱلرَّذِيلَةِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary [food], and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.web: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.
verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֶגְרַ֖ע חֻקֵּ֑ךְ וָאֶתְּנֵ֞ךְ בְּנֶ֤פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּנֹ֣ות פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הַנִּכְלָמֹ֖ות מִדַּרְכֵּ֥ךְ זִמָּֽה׃

verses.ar: وَزَنَيْتِ مَعَ بَنِي أَشُّورَ، إِذْ كُنْتِ لَمْ تَشْبَعِي فَزَنَيْتِ بِهِمْ، وَلَمْ تَشْبَعِي أَيْضًا.
verses.kjv: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
verses.web: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
verses.he: וַתִּזְנִי֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר מִבִּלְתִּ֖י שָׂבְעָתֵ֑ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֕ים וְגַ֖ם לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃

verses.ar: وَكَثَّرْتِ زِنَاكِ فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ إِلَى أَرْضِ ٱلْكَلْدَانِيِّينَ، وَبِهَذَا أَيْضًا لَمْ تَشْبَعِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
verses.web: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.
verses.he: וַתַּרְבִּ֧י אֶת־תַּזְנוּתֵ֛ךְ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ימָה וְגַם־בְּזֹ֖את לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃

verses.ar: مَا أَمْرَضَ قَلْبَكِ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، إِذْ فَعَلْتِ كُلَّ هَذَا فِعْلَ ٱمْرَأَةٍ زَانِيَةٍ سَلِيطَةٍ،
verses.kjv: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these [things], the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.web: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
verses.he: מָ֤ה אֲמֻלָה֙ לִבָּתֵ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה בַּעֲשֹׂותֵךְ֙ אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֔לֶּה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אִשָּֽׁה־זֹונָ֖ה שַׁלָּֽטֶת׃

verses.ar: بِبِنَائِكِ قُبَّتَكِ فِي رَأْسِ كُلِّ طَرِيقٍ، وَصُنْعِكِ مُرْتَفَعَتَكِ فِي كُلِّ شَارِعٍ. وَلَمْ تَكُونِي كَزَانِيَةٍ، بَلْ مُحْتَقَرةً ٱلْأُجْرَةَ.
verses.kjv: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
verses.web: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.
verses.he: בִּבְנֹותַ֤יִךְ גַּבֵּךְ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כָּל־דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְרָמָתֵ֥ךְ *עָשִׂיתִי (עָשִׂ֖ית) בְּכָל־רְחֹ֑וב וְלֹא־*הָיִיתי (הָיִ֥ית) כַּזֹּונָ֖ה לְקַלֵּ֥ס אֶתְנָֽן׃

verses.ar: أَيَّتُهَا ٱلزَّوْجَةُ ٱلْفَاسِقَةُ، تَأْخُذُ أَجْنَبِيِّينَ مَكَانَ زَوْجِهَا.
verses.kjv: [But as] a wife that committeth adultery, [which] taketh strangers instead of her husband!
verses.web: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
verses.he: הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַמְּנָאָ֑פֶת תַּ֣חַת אִישָׁ֔הּ תִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־זָרִֽים׃

verses.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱلزَّوَانِي يُعْطُونَ هَدِيَّةً، أَمَّا أَنْتِ فَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتِ كُلَّ مُحِبِّيكِ هَدَايَاكِ، وَرَشَيْتِهِمْ لِيَأْتُوكِ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ لِلزِّنَا بِكِ.
verses.kjv: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
verses.web: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.
verses.he: לְכָל־זֹנֹ֖ות יִתְּנוּ־נֵ֑דֶה וְאַ֨תְּ נָתַ֤תְּ אֶת־נְדָנַ֙יִךְ֙ לְכָל־מְאַֽהֲבַ֔יִךְ וַתִּשְׁחֳדִ֣י אֹותָ֗ם לָבֹ֥וא אֵלַ֛יִךְ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: وَصَارَ فِيكِ عَكْسُ عَادَةِ ٱلنِّسَاءِ فِي زِنَاكِ، إِذْ لَمْ يُزْنَ وَرَاءَكِ، بَلْ أَنْتِ تُعْطِينَ أُجْرَةً وَلَا أُجْرَةَ تُعْطَى لَكِ، فَصِرْتِ بِٱلْعَكْسِ.
verses.kjv: And the contrary is in thee from [other] women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
verses.web: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’
verses.he: וַיְהִי־בָ֨ךְ הֵ֤פֶךְ מִן־הַנָּשִׁים֙ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֔יִךְ וְאַחֲרַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א זוּנָּ֑ה וּבְתִתֵּ֣ךְ אֶתְנָ֗ן וְאֶתְנַ֛ן לֹ֥א נִתַּן־לָ֖ךְ וַתְּהִ֥י לְהֶֽפֶךְ׃

verses.ar: «فَلِذَلِكَ يَا زَانِيَةُ ٱسْمَعِي كَلَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ:
verses.kjv: ¶ Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.web: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:
verses.he: לָכֵ֣ן זֹונָ֔ה שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר־יְהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أُنْفِقَ نُحَاسُكِ وَٱنْكَشَفَتْ عَوْرَتُكِ بِزِنَاكِ بِمُحِبِّيكِ وَبِكُلِّ أَصْنَامِ رَجَاسَاتِكِ، وَلِدِمَاءِ بَنِيكِ ٱلَّذِينَ بَذَلْتِهِمْ لَهَا،
verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
verses.web: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;
verses.he: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן הִשָּׁפֵ֤ךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ֙ וַתִּגָּלֶ֣ה עֶרְוָתֵ֔ךְ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ עַל־מְאַהֲבָ֑יִךְ וְעַל֙ כָּל־גִּלּוּלֵ֣י תֹועֲבֹותַ֔יִךְ וְכִדְמֵ֣י בָנַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תְּ לָהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ هَأَنَذَا أَجْمَعُ جَمِيعَ مُحِبِّيكِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَذَذْتِ لَهُمْ، وَكُلَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْبَبْتِهِمْ مَعَ كُلِّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَبْغَضْتِهِمْ، فَأَجْمَعُهُمْ عَلَيْكِ مِنْ حَوْلِكِ، وَأَكْشِفُ عَوْرَتَكِ لَهُمْ لِيَنْظُرُوا كُلَّ عَوْرَتِكِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all [them] that thou hast loved, with all [them] that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.web: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.he: לָ֠כֵן הִנְנִ֨י מְקַבֵּ֤ץ אֶת־כָּל־מְאַהֲבַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָרַ֣בְתְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהַ֔בְתְּ עַ֖ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את וְקִבַּצְתִּי֩ אֹתָ֨ם עָלַ֜יִךְ מִסָּבִ֗יב וְגִלֵּיתִ֤י עֶרְוָתֵךְ֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְרָא֖וּ אֶת־כָּל־עֶרְוָתֵֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَأَحْكُمُ عَلَيْكِ أَحْكَامَ ٱلْفَاسِقَاتِ ٱلسَّافِكَاتِ ٱلدَّمِ، وَأَجْعَلُكِ دَمَ ٱلسَّخْطِ وَٱلْغَيْرَةِ.
verses.kjv: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.web: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.he: וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵ֣י נֹאֲפֹ֔ות וְשֹׁפְכֹ֖ת דָּ֑ם וּנְתַתִּ֕יךְ דַּ֥ם חֵמָ֖ה וְקִנְאָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَأُسَلِّمُكِ لِيَدِهِمْ فَيَهْدِمُونَ قُبَّتَكِ وَيُهَدِّمُونَ مُرْتَفَعَاتِكِ، وَيَنْزِعُونَ عَنْكِ ثِيَابَكِ، وَيَأْخُذُونَ أَدَوَاتِ زِينَتِكِ، وَيَتْرُكُونَكِ عُرْيَانَةً وَعَارِيَةً.
verses.kjv: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
verses.web: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.
verses.he: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֹותָ֜ךְ בְּיָדָ֗ם וְהָרְס֤וּ גַבֵּךְ֙ וְנִתְּצ֣וּ רָמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְהִפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אֹותָךְ֙ בְּגָדַ֔יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִנִּיח֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَيُصْعِدُونَ عَلَيْكِ جَمَاعَةً، وَيَرْجُمُونَكِ بِٱلْحِجَارَةِ وَيَقْطَعُونَكِ بِسُيُوفِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.web: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
verses.he: וְהֶעֱל֤וּ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ קָהָ֔ל וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹותָ֖ךְ בָּאָ֑בֶן וּבִתְּק֖וּךְ בְּחַרְבֹותָֽם׃

verses.ar: وَيُحْرِقُونَ بُيُوتَكِ بِٱلنَّارِ، وَيُجْرُونَ عَلَيْكِ أَحْكَامًا قُدَّامَ عُيُونِ نِسَاءٍ كَثِيرَةٍ. وَأَكُفُّكِ عَنِ ٱلزِّنَا، وَأَيْضًا لَا تُعْطِينَ أُجْرَةً بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
verses.web: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.
verses.he: וְשָׂרְפ֤וּ בָתַּ֙יִךְ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעָשׂוּ־בָ֣ךְ שְׁפָטִ֔ים לְעֵינֵ֖י נָשִׁ֣ים רַבֹּ֑ות וְהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ֙ מִזֹּונָ֔ה וְגַם־אֶתְנַ֖ן לֹ֥א תִתְּנִי־עֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: وَأُحِلُّ غَضَبِي بِكِ فَتَنْصَرِفُ غَيْرَتِي عَنْكِ، فَأَسْكُنُ وَلَا أَغْضَبُ بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.web: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.
verses.he: וַהֲנִחֹתִ֤י חֲמָתִי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְסָ֥רָה קִנְאָתִ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֣קַטְתִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א אֶכְעַ֖ס עֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّكِ لَمْ تَذْكُرِي أَيَّامَ صِبَاكِ، بَلْ أَسْخَطْتِنِي فِي كُلِّ هَذِهِ، فَهَأَنَذَا أَيْضًا أَجْلِبُ طَرِيقَكِ عَلَى رَأْسِكِ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، فَلَا تَفْعَلِينَ هَذِهِ ٱلرَّذِيلَةَ فَوْقَ رَجَاسَاتِكِ كُلِّهَا.
verses.kjv: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these [things;] behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon [thine] head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
verses.web: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.
verses.he: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־*זָכַרְתִּי (זָכַרְתְּ֙) אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ וַתִּרְגְּזִי־לִ֖י בְּכָל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְגַם־אֲנִ֨י הֵ֜א דַּרְכֵּ֣ךְ ׀ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ נָתַ֗תִּי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְלֹ֤א *עָשִׂיתִי (עָשִׂית֙) אֶת־הַזִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־תֹּועֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا كُلُّ ضَارِبِ مَثَلٍ يَضْرِبُ مَثَلًا عَلَيْكِ قَائِلًا: مِثْلُ ٱلْأُمِّ بِنْتُهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use [this] proverb against thee, saying, As [is] the mother, [so is] her daughter.
verses.web: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’
verses.he: הִנֵּה֙ כָּל־הַמֹּשֵׁ֔ל עָלַ֥יִךְ יִמְשֹׁ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּאִמָּ֖ה בִּתָּֽהּ׃

verses.ar: اِبْنَةُ أُمِّكِ أَنْتِ، ٱلْكَارِهَةُ زَوْجَهَا وَبَنِيهَا. وَأَنْتِ أُخْتُ أَخَوَاتِكِ ٱللَّوَاتِي كَرِهْنَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ وَأَبْنَاءَهُنَّ. أُمُّكُنَّ حِثِّيَّةٌ وَأَبُوكُنَّ أَمُورِيٌّ.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou [art] the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother [was] an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.web: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.he: בַּת־אִמֵּ֣ךְ אַ֔תְּ גֹּעֶ֥לֶת אִישָׁ֖הּ וּבָנֶ֑יהָ וַאֲחֹ֨ות אֲחֹותֵ֜ךְ אַ֗תְּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר גָּֽעֲ֙לוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ן וּבְנֵיהֶ֔ן אִמְּכֶ֣ן חִתִּ֔ית וַאֲבִיכֶ֖ן אֱמֹרִֽי׃

verses.ar: وَأُخْتُكِ ٱلْكُبْرَى ٱلسَّامِرَةُ هِيَ وَبَنَاتُهَا ٱلسَّاكِنَةُ عَنْ شِمَالِكِ، وَأُخْتُكِ ٱلصُّغْرَى ٱلسَّاكِنَةُ عَنْ يَمِينِكِ هِيَ سَدُومُ وَبَنَاتُهَا.
verses.kjv: And thine elder sister [is] Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, [is] Sodom and her daughters.
verses.web: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.
verses.he: וַאֲחֹותֵ֨ךְ הַגְּדֹולָ֤ה שֹֽׁמְרֹון֙ הִ֣יא וּבְנֹותֶ֔יהָ הַיֹּושֶׁ֖בֶת עַל־שְׂמֹאולֵ֑ךְ וַאֲחֹותֵ֞ךְ הַקְּטַנָּ֣ה מִמֵּ֗ךְ הַיֹּושֶׁ֙בֶת֙ מִֽימִינֵ֔ךְ סְדֹ֖ם וּבְנֹותֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: وَلَا فِي طَرِيقِهِنَّ سَلَكْتِ، وَلَا مِثْلَ رَجَاسَاتِهِنَّ فَعَلْتِ، كَأَنَّ ذَلِكَ قَلِيلٌ فَقَطْ، فَفَسَدْتِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُنَّ فِي كُلِّ طُرُقِكِ.
verses.kjv: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as [if that were] a very little [thing], thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
verses.web: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
verses.he: וְלֹ֤א בְדַרְכֵיהֶן֙ הָלַ֔כְתְּ וּבְתֹועֲבֹֽותֵיהֶ֖ן *עָשִׂיתִי (עָשִׂ֑ית) כִּמְעַ֣ט קָ֔ט וַתַּשְׁחִ֥תִי מֵהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: حَيٌّ أَنَا، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ، إِنَّ سَدُومَ أُخْتَكِ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ هِيَ وَلَا بَنَاتُهَا كَمَا فَعَلْتِ أَنْتِ وَبَنَاتُكِ.
verses.kjv: [As] I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.web: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
verses.he: חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־עָֽשְׂתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחֹותֵ֔ךְ הִ֖יא וּבְנֹותֶ֑יהָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית אַ֖תְּ וּבְנֹותָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: هَذَا كَانَ إِثْمَ أُخْتِكِ سَدُومَ: ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَٱلشَّبَعُ مِنَ ٱلْخُبْزِ وَسَلَامُ ٱلِٱطْمِئْنَانِ كَانَ لَهَا وَلِبَنَاتِهَا، وَلَمْ تُشَدِّدْ يَدَ ٱلْفَقِيرِ وَٱلْمِسْكِينِ،
verses.kjv: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.web: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.he: הִנֵּה־זֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה עֲוֹ֖ן סְדֹ֣ם אֲחֹותֵ֑ךְ גָּאֹ֨ון שִׂבְעַת־לֶ֜חֶם וְשַׁלְוַ֣ת הַשְׁקֵ֗ט הָ֤יָה לָהּ֙ וְלִבְנֹותֶ֔יהָ וְיַד־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֹ֖ון לֹ֥א הֶחֱזִֽיקָה׃

verses.ar: وَتَكَبَّرْنَ وَعَمِلْنَ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَمَامِي فَنَزَعْتُهُنَّ كَمَا رَأَيْتُ.
verses.kjv: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw [good].
verses.web: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
verses.he: וַֽתִּגְבְּהֶ֔ינָה וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה תֹועֵבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י וָאָסִ֥יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃ ס

verses.ar: وَلَمْ تُخْطِئِ ٱلسَّامِرَةُ نِصْفَ خَطَايَاكِ. بَلْ زِدْتِ رَجَاسَاتِكِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُنَّ، وَبَرَّرْتِ أَخَوَاتِكِ بِكُلِّ رَجَاسَاتِكِ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلْتِ.
verses.kjv: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.web: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.
verses.he: וְשֹׁ֣מְרֹ֔ון כַּחֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א חָטָ֑אָה וַתַּרְבִּ֤י אֶת־תֹּועֲבֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵהֵ֔נָּה וַתְּצַדְּקִי֙ אֶת־*אֲחֹותֵךְ (אֲחֹותַ֔יִךְ) בְּכָל־תֹּועֲבֹותַ֖יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר *עָשִׂיתי (עָשִֽׂית)׃

verses.ar: فَٱحْمِلِي أَيْضًا خِزْيَكِ، أَنْتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةُ عَلَى أَخَوَاتِكِ، بِخَطَايَاكِ ٱلَّتِي بِهَا رَجَسْتِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُنَّ. هُنَّ أَبَرُّ مِنْكِ، فَٱخْجَلِي أَنْتِ أَيْضًا، وَٱحْمِلِي عَارَكِ بِتَبْرِيرِكِ أَخَوَاتِكِ.
verses.kjv: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.web: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
verses.he: גַּם־אַ֣תְּ ׀ שְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֗ךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּלַּלְתְּ֙ לַֽאֲחֹותֵ֔ךְ בְּחַטֹּאתַ֛יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַ֥בְתְּ מֵהֵ֖ן תִּצְדַּ֣קְנָה מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־אַ֥תְּ בֹּ֙ושִׁי֙ וּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ בְּצַדֶּקְתֵּ֖ךְ אַחְיֹותֵֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَأُرَجِّعُ سَبْيَهُنَّ، سَبْيَ سَدُومَ وَبَنَاتِهَا، وَسَبْيَ ٱلسَّامِرَةِ وَبَنَاتِهَا، وَسَبْيَ مَسْبِيِّيكِ فِي وَسْطِهَا،
verses.kjv: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then [will I bring again] the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
verses.web: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;
verses.he: וְשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־שְׁבִ֣יתְהֶ֔ן אֶת־*שְׁבִית (שְׁב֤וּת) סְדֹם֙ וּבְנֹותֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־*שְׁבִית (שְׁב֥וּת) שֹׁמְרֹ֖ון וּבְנֹותֶ֑יהָ *וּשְׁבִית (וּשְׁב֥וּת) שְׁבִיתַ֖יִךְ בְּתֹוכָֽהְנָה׃

verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَحْمِلِي عَارَكِ وَتَخْزَيْ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا فَعَلْتِ بِتَعْزِيَتِكِ إِيَّاهُنَّ.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.web: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.
verses.he: לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ וְנִכְלַ֕מְתְּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית בְּנַחֲמֵ֖ךְ אֹתָֽן׃

verses.ar: وَأَخَوَاتُكِ سَدُومُ وَبَنَاتُهَا يَرْجِعْنَ إِلَى حَالَتِهِنَّ ٱلْقَدِيمَةِ، وَٱلسَّامِرَةُ وَبَنَاتُهَا يَرْجِعْنَ إِلَى حَالَتِهِنَّ ٱلْقَدِيمَةِ، وَأَنْتِ وَبَنَاتُكِ تَرْجِعْنَ إِلَى حَالَتِكُنَّ ٱلْقَدِيمَةِ.
verses.kjv: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.web: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.
verses.he: וַאֲחֹותַ֗יִךְ סְדֹ֤ם וּבְנֹותֶ֙יהָ֙ תָּשֹׁ֣בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֔ן וְשֹֽׁמְרֹון֙ וּבְנֹותֶ֔יהָ תָּשֹׁ֖בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֑ן וְאַתְּ֙ וּבְנֹותַ֔יִךְ תְּשֻׁבֶ֖ינָה לְקַדְמַתְכֶֽן׃

verses.ar: وَأُخْتُكِ سَدُومُ لَمْ تَكُنْ تُذْكَرْ فِي فَمِكِ يَوْمَ كِبْرِيَائِكِ،
verses.kjv: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
verses.web: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.he: וְלֹ֤וא הָֽיְתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחֹותֵ֔ךְ לִשְׁמוּעָ֖ה בְּפִ֑יךְ בְּיֹ֖ום גְּאֹונָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: قَبْلَ مَا ٱنْكَشَفَ شَرُّكِ، كَمَا فِي زَمَانِ تَعْيِيرِ بَنَاتِ أَرَامَ وَكُلِّ مَنْ حَوْلَهَا، بَنَاتِ ٱلْفِلِسْطِينِيِّينَ ٱللَّوَاتِي يَحْتَقِرْنَكِ مِنْ كُلِّ جِهَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of [thy] reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all [that are] round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
verses.web: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.
verses.he: בְּטֶרֶם֮ תִּגָּלֶ֣ה רָעָתֵךְ֒ כְּמֹ֗ו עֵ֚ת חֶרְפַּ֣ת בְּנֹות־אֲרָ֔ם וְכָל־סְבִיבֹותֶ֖יהָ בְּנֹ֣ות פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים הַשָּׁאטֹ֥ות אֹותָ֖ךְ מִסָּבִֽיב׃

verses.ar: رَذِيلَتُكِ وَرَجَاسَاتُكِ أَنْتِ تَحْمِلِينَهَا، يَقُولُ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
verses.web: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.
verses.he: אֶת־זִמָּתֵ֥ךְ וְאֶת־תֹּועֲבֹותַ֖יִךְ אַ֣תְּ נְשָׂאתִ֑ים נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ ס

verses.ar: «لِأَنَّهُ هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: إِنِّي أَفْعَلُ بِكِ كَمَا فَعَلْتِ، إِذِ ٱزْدَرَيْتِ بِٱلْقَسَمِ لِنَكْثِ ٱلْعَهْدِ.
verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.web: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.he: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה *וְעָשִׂית (וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי) אֹותָ֖ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית אֲשֶׁר־בָּזִ֥ית אָלָ֖ה לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽית׃

verses.ar: وَلَكِنِّي أَذْكُرُ عَهْدِي مَعَكِ فِي أَيَّامِ صِبَاكِ، وَأُقِيمُ لَكِ عَهْدًا أَبَدِيًّا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.web: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
verses.he: וְזָכַרְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֛י אֹותָ֖ךְ בִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ וַהֲקִמֹותִ֥י לָ֖ךְ בְּרִ֥ית עֹולָֽם׃

verses.ar: فَتَتَذَكَّرِينَ طُرُقَكِ وَتَخْجَلِينَ إِذْ تَقْبَلِينَ أَخَوَاتِكِ ٱلْكِبَرَ وَٱلصِّغَرَ، وَأَجْعَلُهُنَّ لَكِ بَنَاتٍ، وَلَكِنْ لَا بِعَهْدِكِ.
verses.kjv: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
verses.web: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
verses.he: וְזָכַ֣רְתְּ אֶת־דְּרָכַיִךְ֮ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ֒ בְּקַחְתֵּ֗ךְ אֶת־אֲחֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ הַגְּדֹלֹ֣ות מִמֵּ֔ךְ אֶל־הַקְּטַנֹּ֖ות מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶתְהֶ֥ן לָ֛ךְ לְבָנֹ֖ות וְלֹ֥א מִבְּרִיתֵֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَأَنَا أُقِيمُ عَهْدِي مَعَكِ، فَتَعْلَمِينَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ،
verses.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I [am] the LORD:
verses.web: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;
verses.he: וַהֲקִימֹותִ֥י אֲנִ֛י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَتَذَكَّرِي فَتَخْزَيْ وَلَا تَفْتَحِي فَاكِ بَعْدُ بِسَبَبِ خِزْيِكِ، حِينَ أَغْفِرُ لَكِ كُلَّ مَا فَعَلْتِ، يَقُولُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.kjv: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.web: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
verses.he: לְמַ֤עַן תִּזְכְּרִי֙ וָבֹ֔שְׁתְּ וְלֹ֨א יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֥ךְ עֹוד֙ פִּתְחֹ֣ון פֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י כְּלִמָּתֵ֑ךְ בְּכַפְּרִי־לָךְ֙ לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ ס
